key_insight: CNN and SVC achieved high brain tumor classification accuracy on MRI datasets, with CNN leading on the larger benchmark.
clinical_relevance: These findings suggest potential for MRI-based tumor assessment support, but do not establish readiness for clinical use.
method: Compared six feature representations, including LBP, Gabor filters, wavelets and CNN features.
Evaluated five learning algorithms, including SVC, CNN and Random Forest.
Used SHAP to identify influential features and statistical tests to assess LBP feature significance.
evidence_signal: Reported accuracy was 97.8% for CNN and 98.06% for SVC on a small dataset, versus 98.9% and 96.7%, respectively, on a larger benchmark dataset.
watch_item: The abstract does not report dataset sizes or independent clinical validation, limiting assessment of real-world generalizability.
paper_title: Enhanced MRI brain tumor detection using deep learning in conjunction with explainable AI SHAP based diverse and multi feature analysis
